cases.name: Denethor, Ruling Steward
cases.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died under your control this turn, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.
{2}, Sacrifice another creature: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
cases.expectation: Own controlled creature death; intervening-if checked at end-step trigger and again at resolution; separate sacrifice ability.

cases.name: Hunger of the Howlpack
cases.oracle_text:
Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
Morbid — Put three +1/+1 counters on that creature instead if a creature died this turn.
cases.expectation: Any creature death this turn; three counters instead of one at resolution.

cases.name: Grave Pact
cases.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control dies, each other player sacrifices a creature of their choice.
cases.expectation: Direct death trigger; each other player sacrifices. Verify catalog availability separately.

cases.name: Grim Haruspex
cases.oracle_text:
Morph {B} (You may cast this card face down as a 2/2 creature for {3}. Turn it face up any time for its morph cost.)
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, draw a card.
cases.expectation: Direct death trigger, not a history check.

cases.name: Tannuk, Memorial Ensign
cases.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, Tannuk deals 1 damage to each opponent. If this is the second time this ability has resolved this turn, draw a card.
cases.expectation: Land entry and this ability's second resolution, not trigger count or independent state.

cases.name: Hardened Scales
cases.oracle_text: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on a creature you control, that many plus one +1/+1 counters are put on it instead.
cases.expectation: Counter placement replacement, not a triggered response or independent state gate.

cases.name: Scute Swarm
cases.oracle_text: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, create a 1/1 green Insect creature token. If you control six or more lands, create a token that's a copy of this creature instead.
cases.expectation: Land-entry trigger; six controlled lands checked at resolution; copy remains unresolved.

cases.name: Tragic Slip
cases.oracle_text:
Target creature gets -1/-1 until end of turn.
Morbid — That creature gets -13/-13 until end of turn instead if a creature died this turn.
cases.expectation: Any creature death this turn; -13/-13 instead of -1/-1 at resolution, no death trigger.
